text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this! Over the break,
I went fishing with Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When I caught a whoooole bunch, everyone around me
praised me saying, "Now that's a big catch!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Next time, I wanna reel in an even bigger catch~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black thoroughly enjoyed her time off and seems to have fully recharged her batteries!
